afterImage.name: Kindle Energy
afterImage.subsector: Power generation development, ownership and asset management
afterImage.description: Kindle Energy is a Blackstone-owned North American power-generation platform that develops, acquires, manages and operates generation assets. The platform serves utilities, cooperatives, municipalities, commercial and industrial buyers and wholesale power markets, and reported a roughly 11 GW operating portfolio by early 2026. Kindle was founded in 2015 as a Blackstone portfolio company. Its Magnolia Power Generating Station is a 694 MW combined-cycle natural-gas project in Plaquemine, Louisiana: development began in 2021, construction began in 2022, a $580 million financing was completed in 2025, and commercial operation began in February 2026. Magnolia Power LLC is retained as Kindle's project subsidiary and operating asset rather than counted as a separate manager-level PortCo. Public evidence identifies Blackstone Capital Partners VII and Blackstone Energy Partners II in the platform financing chain but does not disclose exact fund, Kindle or Magnolia equity percentages. No later platform sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 23, 2026.
